title: Loot table
description: What a roll can give (#90). A species table's blank entry rolls again on the instance's table; an instance table has no blank. Chances are thousandths and add up to 1000 (100 %). One file per table, named after its id.

id.description: Stable, never reused: lowercase words joined by underscores.

kind.description: A species table (rolled when a monster is dominated, #86) or an instance table (a blank's second roll, chests, #124).

oneOf.description: An item, in an amount rolled from min to max.
The blank: a roll on the instance's table instead.
